alertForNoData.description: The triggered alert level if we cannot collect data for this datapoint. The values can be 1-4 (1:no alert, 2:warn alert, 3:error alert, 4:critical alert)

globalAlertForNoData.description: The triggered alert level if we cannot collect data for this datapoint. The values can be 1-4 (1:no alert, 2:warn alert, 3:error alert, 4:critical alert)

alertClearTransitionInterval.description: The count that the alert must exist for this many poll cycles before the alert will be cleared (0-60)

globalAlertTransitionInterval.description: The count that the alert must exist for this many poll cycles before it will be triggered

globalAlertClearTransitionInterval.description: The count that the alert must exist for this many poll cycles before the alert will be cleared

alertTransitionInterval.description: The count that the alert must exist for this many poll cycles before it will be triggered (0-60)
